pairs.difference: A has a long, narrow mouthpiece and a small attachment ring. B has a broader, thicker mouthpiece, a larger round chamber and an oversized ring.
pairs.fix: Draw a slimmer whistle with a longer narrow mouthpiece, a smaller round chamber and a thin, modest attachment ring.

pairs.difference: A has slender tubing, fine cord wraps and small tassels. B thickens the loop into a heavy tube and enlarges the cord and tassels into bulky rounded parts.
pairs.fix: Use slender brass tubing, thin cord wound tightly around the lower tube and small tassels with fine hanging strands.

pairs.difference: A has a larger cup, thicker handle and raised flower; B has a smaller cup and slimmer handle. Both retain a coherent bowl, open handle, foot and shallow saucer without a clear proportion defect.
A has a taller basket with broad woven strips; B has a wider basket with a rope rim. Both preserve a clear handle opening and plausible relationships between basket, handle and apples.
A has flatter metal hoops and longer straight runs along the staves. B has thicker, rounded hoops, bulging stave ends around the opening and large projecting rivets.
pairs.fix: Draw flatter, thinner metal hoops with small rivets. Keep the wooden staves broad and gently curved, with a thin, even top edge.

pairs.difference: A has an elongated body, low roof sign and restrained bumper. B shortens and raises the body while enlarging the headlights, roof sign, wheels and rounded bumper guards.
pairs.fix: Draw a longer, lower taxi with smaller headlights and roof sign, modest wheels and a slim bumper close to the body.

pairs.difference: A has broad, relatively straight fabric runs, thin guy ropes and small stakes. B adds thick projecting roof poles, chunky rope ties and rounded fastening tabs around the entrance.
pairs.fix: Keep the tent fabric in broad taut planes. Use thin guy ropes, small stakes, slender roof supports and small flat entrance fastenings.

pairs.difference: A has upright slender supports, a thin high handle and a deep pot with a nearly straight upper wall. B uses heavy splayed logs, bulky rope bindings, a thick handle and a squat bulbous pot.
pairs.fix: Draw slender upright wooden supports and a straight crossbar. Hang a deep pot with straighter upper sides from a thin arched metal handle; keep bindings small and tight.

pairs.difference: Recurring pattern: slender attachments become bulky, rounded parts grow relative to the main body, and straight structural runs give way to swollen contours.

pattern: Recurring pattern: slender attachments become bulky, rounded parts grow relative to the main body, and straight structural runs give way to swollen contours.
